purpose: Adds a default-model picker, temperature/max-tokens generation defaults, and a credential-blind Test Connection button to the DuoPort Connector settings.
riskRationale: Changes are additive inside the plugin-owned option, stay credential-blind (no connectors_ai_* value reads), fail open on every WP touchpoint, and verify clean: phpcs exit 0, phpunit OK (46 tests, 151 assertions).

text: Well-structured, convention-following PR: pure verdict mapper, clamped sanitizers with caller-wins merge, nonced/capability-checked AJAX handler, and sorted/deduped picker sourced from the allowlist. All eight previously reported minors verified fixed in the current tree. Two new residual minors (non-blocking) noted below.

reasoning: All four subagent dispatches failed (free-tier provider restriction: OpenCode free tier usable only from within OpenCode), so review continued via direct file reads; direct verification shows phpcs clean, phpunit OK 46/151, credential-blind grep clean, and all 8 prior minors fixed — remaining 2 minors are non-blocking.

message: map_verdict() is pure and unit-testable with correct contract: 2xx/429/401+CreditsError map to connected, other 401s to invalid_key, exceptions/5xx/other 4xx to network_error.

AJAX handler enforces manage_options capability plus nonce (check_ajax_referer primary, wp_unslash-aware wp_verify_nonce fallback) and rejects unknown catalogs with bad_request 400 instead of probing both.
Generation-default merge is caller-wins, gap-fills null/false/empty-string, allowlist-guards the model, and fails open; sanitize clamps (temperature 0-2, max_tokens 1-8192 via int cast) are correct.

stored_options() and render paths read only the plugin-owned option, guard every WP function with function_exists, and bust verdict transients without touching connectors_ai_* values (grep shows comment mentions only).

check_connection() normalizes any non-go catalog to zen for the verdict/transient key, but isConfigured() reads the legacy bool cache with the raw constructor catalog, so a garbage catalog would split cache keys (probe writes zen keys, isConfigured reads the garbage key). No live impact since callers only pass go/zen, but the normalization is inconsistent.
suggestion: Normalize the catalog once (constructor or private helper) and use it in both isConfigured() and check_connection()/execute_probe().

message: Capability gate is fail-open when current_user_can() is undefined: if the function does not exist the capability check is skipped entirely rather than denying. In real WP the function always exists so risk is negligible, but default-deny is the safer pattern for an AJAX probe endpoint.
suggestion: Deny when the capability API is unavailable instead of skipping the check.
